actions.ask-ai.description: Send a question or instruction to a Groq model and get a text reply.
actions.ask-ai.props.frequencyPenalty.de: From -2 to 2. Groq models do not support this yet.
actions.ask-ai.props.maxTokens.descripti: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each.
actions.ask-ai.props.memoryInfo.descript: Saved for the whole project, so other flows that use this ID join the same conversation.
actions.ask-ai.props.memoryKey.descripti: Runs that share this ID continue one conversation. Empty: no memory.
actions.ask-ai.props.model.description: Speech models are left out; use the audio actions for them.
actions.ask-ai.props.presencePenalty.des: From -2 to 2. Groq models do not support this yet.
actions.ask-ai.props.prompt.description: What you want the model to answer or do.
actions.ask-ai.props.roles.description: Messages sent before the question, such as a system instruction.
actions.ask-ai.props.temperature.descrip: From 0 to 2. Lower is more focused, higher is more varied.
actions.ask-ai.props.topP.description: From 0 to 1. Adjust this or Temperature, not both.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.groq_create_chat_completion.desc: Send a conversation to a Groq model and get its reply.
actions.groq_create_chat_completion.prop: Any other request body fields from the Groq API reference, as a JSON object. The dedicated inputs above override keys set here.
Forces a JSON reply matching this schema (Structured Outputs), as {"name": "...", "schema": {...}, "strict": true}. Only some models support it. Leave empty for plain text.
Upper limit on generated tokens, reasoning included. Defaults to the model maximum.
The conversation as a JSON array of messages, oldest first, e.g. [{"role": "system", "content": "Be brief."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]. Roles: system, user, assistant, tool.
Groq model ID, e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-20b". Use List Models to find the IDs on this account.
For reasoning models only: none, default, low, medium or high. Supported values differ per model.
For reasoning models only: "parsed" returns reasoning in its own field, "raw" keeps it in the content, "hidden" drops it.
Best-effort deterministic sampling: repeat calls with the same seed and inputs tend to match.
Up to 4 strings that end generation. The reply does not include them.
Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Lower is more focused. Defaults to 1.
"auto" lets the model decide, "required" forces a tool call, "none" forbids one. Defaults to "auto" when tools are given.
Functions the model may call, as a JSON array in the OpenAI format: [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}}].
Nucleus sampling from 0 to 1. Set this or Temperature, not both. Defaults to 1.
actions.groq_create_response.description: Generate a model response with the Responses API.
actions.groq_create_response.props.addit: Any other request body fields from the Groq API reference, as a JSON object. The dedicated inputs above override keys set here.
actions.groq_create_response.props.input: The text the model responds to. For a list of input items, leave this empty and set "input" in Additional Fields.
actions.groq_create_response.props.instr: A system message placed first in the model context.
actions.groq_create_response.props.jsonS: Forces a JSON reply matching this schema, as {"name": "...", "schema": {...}, "strict": true}. Leave empty for plain text.
actions.groq_create_response.props.maxOu: Upper limit on generated tokens, reasoning included.
actions.groq_create_response.props.model: Groq model ID, e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-20b". Use List Models to find the IDs on this account.
actions.groq_create_response.props.reaso: For reasoning models only: low, medium or high.
actions.groq_create_response.props.tempe: Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Lower is more focused. Defaults to 1.
actions.groq_create_response.props.tools: Functions the model may call, as a JSON array: [{"type": "function", "name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}]. Up to 128.
Nucleus sampling from 0 to 1. Set this or Temperature, not both.
actions.groq_create_speech.props.respons: flac, mp3, mulaw, ogg or wav. Defaults to wav.
actions.groq_create_speech.props.speed.d: Playback speed of the generated audio. 1 is normal.
actions.groq_create_speech.props.voice.d: Voice name for the model, e.g. "troy", "austin" or "hannah" for English.
actions.groq_create_transcription.descri: Turn speech in an audio file into text in the spoken language.
The audio file: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav or webm, up to 25 MB. Give either this or Audio URL, not both.
Public URL of the audio file, for files over 25 MB. Give either this or Audio File, not both.
ISO-639-1 code of the spoken language, e.g. "en". Improves accuracy and speed. Detected when empty.
Whisper model ID: "whisper-large-v3" or the faster "whisper-large-v3-turbo".
Text that guides spelling and style, in the language of the audio.
"json" returns the text; "verbose_json" adds language, duration and timed segments. Defaults to "json".
Sampling temperature from 0 to 1. Groq recommends 0, the default.
Add "word" and/or "segment" timestamps. Needs Response Format "verbose_json".
actions.groq_create_translation.descript: Turn speech in any language into English text.
actions.groq_create_translation.props.au: The audio file: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav or webm, up to 25 MB. Give either this or Audio URL, not both.
Public URL of the audio file, for files over 25 MB. Give either this or Audio File, not both.
actions.groq_create_translation.props.pr: English text that guides spelling and style.
actions.groq_create_translation.props.re: "json" returns the text; "verbose_json" adds language, duration and timed segments. Defaults to "json".
actions.groq_create_translation.props.te: Sampling temperature from 0 to 1. Groq recommends 0, the default.
actions.groq_get_model.description: Get the details of one Groq model.
actions.groq_get_model.props.modelId.des: Groq model ID, e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-20b". Use List Models to find the IDs on this account.
actions.groq_list_models.description: List the models available to your Groq account.
actions.transcribe-audio.description: Turn speech in an audio file into text, in the language spoken.
actions.transcribe-audio.props.file.desc: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav or webm.
ISO-639-1 code of the spoken language, for better accuracy.
actions.transcribe-audio.props.model.des: whisper-large-v3 is the most accurate; turbo is faster.
actions.transcribe-audio.props.prompt.de: Spellings or text that came just before, in the audio's language.
actions.transcribe-audio.props.responseF: Text returns the words alone; Verbose JSON adds segment timings.
actions.translate-audio.description: Turn speech in any supported language into English text.
actions.translate-audio.props.file.descr: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav or webm.
actions.translate-audio.props.model.desc: Use whisper-large-v3; the turbo model cannot translate.
actions.translate-audio.props.prompt.des: Spellings or earlier text in English to guide the translation.
actions.translate-audio.props.responseFo: Text returns the words alone; Verbose JSON adds segment timings.
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open [console.groq.com/keys](https://console.groq.com/keys).
2. Click **Create API Key**, name it, and copy it.
description: Use Groq's fast language models and audio processing capabilities.
